units: decimal returns; multiply by 100 for percentage points

check_names: raw does not require B65 readiness

inventory.definitions: Existing maturity NaN=label not generated; maturity<0=censored marker; other label-unready rows separate. State exclusions and label exclusions may overlap. No outcomes generated or filled.

full_period_raw.capacity_note: Simple z1&S1 mature filled attempts are an optimistic upper bound on completed trades among these existing mature opportunities. Overlap, capital occupation and execution sequencing can reduce feasible trades. This is not executable frequency; censored/missing-label opportunities remain separate and are not claimed impossible. No B65 completeness requirement. 2020-2022 are already-seen raw descriptions, not independently validated trading years.

duration.note: Existing H1 labels, identical fixed H3 model scores and selections; no H1 refit or horizon replacement. Residual differences cancel score_M1. Does not recover H1-only opportunities absent from H3-mature predictions.

old5_counterevidence.note: Old direction does not determine the primary common queue; same S and existing Y3, descriptive only. Residual subtracts existing one-day-z M1, not an old5 fitted baseline.

holding.rule: Inclusive realised entry/maturity connected components; unfilled zero attempts are singleton units. Equal-cluster row weight=1/cluster size, group denominators recomputed. Dedup uses realised future exits, is diagnostic only, not a tradable schedule or frequency capacity proof.

favorable_trimming.rule: Each statistic ranks its own signed contribution to the original full-parent statistic; remove top 1/3/5 globally and within each year, even if zero/negative; signal date resolves ties. Recompute every denominator; missing cells remain invalid. Sensitivity only, never choose a preferred specification.

bootstrap.method: Year-stratified nonoverlapping 20-trading-day calendar blocks; short last block retained; draw original block count per year. Empty days retained. All denominators recomputed. Fixed-score conditional percentile intervals; no training uncertainty or historical selection adjustment. Main pair: raw D and M2-minus-M1 allocation, Bonferroni 1.25/98.75 percentiles on joint-valid draws.

inventory.note: Predictions contain complete mature common rows only. Missing calendar rows are listed, not automatically called censored. Preparation inventory supplies reasons and the immutable full maturity/truncation inventory; no labels reconstructed here.

limits: Already-seen adaptive development hypothesis, not independent confirmation or causal commodity effect.
Opportunity labels and allocations are not continuous account returns; realised overlap is diagnostic, not an executable schedule.
Conditional fixed-score intervals omit training uncertainty and historical hypothesis selection; missing groups never filled.
Relative loss reduction alone does not establish a useful long entry; compare absolute, all-parent and stock-only participation.
No year-specific positivity gate, new economic acceptance gate, new threshold, direction, horizon or model selection.
